answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the hollow check. Bindings are kept in falcon, verified in jade, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Each duplicate costs another 29 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
